rule: GOAL: Match the top color sequence by filling the empty slots below it. CONTROLS: Click a bottom palette color to select it, then click a slot to place it. RULE: Each palette color is consumed after one placement, ensuring a one-to-one match. TRAP: Thinking you could place multiple colors at once or that slots fill automatically without selecting a specific color first.

GOAL: Position the moving platform beneath the falling block, then carry it to the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the platform in four-cell steps; Space drops the block onto the platform. RULE: The block rides the platform once it lands on top, sharing its movement. TRAP: Assuming the block bounces off or stays stationary when the platform moves; it actually travels with the platform.

GOAL: Reach the marked target from the start in a maze. CONTROLS: Arrows move one room per step. RULE: Parity of room coordinates determines valid paths. TRAP: Using current position as origin breaks room indexing.

GOAL: Shift the gray strip so its upper arm aligns with the yellow gap to allow flow. CONTROLS: Clicking the lower blue block extends the upper arm rightward while retracting the lower arm. RULE: Gray length is conserved; extending one section strictly shortens the other, requiring precise alignment. TRAP: Believing the gray neck moves independently; it is fixed relative to the wall, not the strip.

GOAL: Move the token along the dotted diagonal path to the blue circle. CONTROLS: Click on a dot position to slide the token to that spot. RULE: You can only move the token up to three dot-steps per click. TRAP: Clicking a dot more than three steps ahead does nothing; it is out of range.

GOAL: Align the plug’s blade with the wall’s gap columns to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Top buttons shift the gray arm left or right; bottom buttons move the plug vertically. RULE: The level ends only when the plug’s columns match the gap’s columns, regardless of the arm’s position. TRAP: Mistakenly assuming the gray arm must physically cover the gap, leading to unnecessary arm adjustments.

GOAL: Align colored tiles with the hidden path sequence. CONTROLS: Click a tile to select it, then click another to swap them. Press space to submit the pattern. RULE: The pipe acts as a fixed green anchor; read tiles in a specific winding order around it. TRAP: Assuming the pipe is empty space rather than a green tile in the sequence.

GOAL: Fill seven slots in three boxes to form a valid tree structure. CONTROLS: Click palette tiles to place them; click slot to remove; press space to submit. RULE: Fill slots via in-order traversal, reading children left to right before their parent. TRAP: Assuming pipes dictate slot order; they merely mark connections, not sequence.

GOAL: Program a sequence of five moves to slide the T-shape into the U-shape. CONTROLS: Click bars to toggle move directions; click the blob to execute the program. RULE: Black bars command moves, white bars wait; Down is black-black, Left is black-white. TRAP: Assuming moves depend on slot position, not the bar pattern itself.

GOAL: Guide the shrinking tip through the narrow neck to reach the handle. CONTROLS: Click to pump the plunger; arrows to move the tip. RULE: The tip alternates size; only the small state fits the tight passage. TRAP: Thinking the timer bar limits moves; it is just an ink supply.

GOAL: Combine duplicate tokens inside the circle to create a higher-tier symbol. CONTROLS: Click near a token to slide it toward the cursor until it stops or hits another token. RULE: Identical tokens merge into the next tier only when they occupy adjacent cells inside the target circle. TRAP: Believing merges happen anywhere; attempting to combine tokens outside the circle wastes moves with no result.

GOAL: Connect the green box to the frame using the pre-placed green tile as a positional anchor. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select them, then click empty slots to place tiles or the frame. RULE: The frame must align vertically with the pre-placed tile to satisfy the sequence constraint. TRAP: Assuming any frame position works; misalignment breaks the logic chain and wastes moves.

GOAL: Match the yellow stencil dots to paint the white grid cells, then push the syringe plunger upward through the narrow neck. CONTROLS: Click white cells to paint them; use arrow keys to move the plunger. RULE: Completing the dot pattern shrinks the plunger, allowing it to fit through the restricted barrel opening. TRAP: Attempting to push the full-sized plunger up immediately fails because it is too wide for the neck.

GOAL: Drop three matching blocks into the bottom slots to clear the row. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player and attached block; Space drops the held block. RULE: Hold a block by walking beneath it; the white face must point up to attach. TRAP: Believing a block stays highlighted after placement; it reverts color but remains secured.

GOAL: Align five pink shapes to match their paired blue partners. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor and rotate the current shape. RULE: The level clears only when all five columns display correct pairs simultaneously. TRAP: Checking one column at a time wastes moves; the win requires the entire board to be correct at once.

GOAL: Merge pairs of blocks into larger units, then deliver the resulting shapes into matching target zones. CONTROLS: Clicking a block moves it toward the cursor; clicking near a compatible block merges them instantly. RULE: Blocks merge only when their edges align perfectly after moving close enough to touch. TRAP: Moving blocks randomly wastes actions; plan straight paths to align edges before attempting a merge.

GOAL: Clear the blockage and drive the plunger into the handle. CONTROLS: Arrows move the plunger. The pump clears obstacles when pushed through them. RULE: The pump removes any plug it touches, opening the path to the target. TRAP: Believing the blockage is permanent. Pushing the pump through it clears the way instantly.

GOAL: Arrange white blocks so pockets 1, 4, and 5 reach specific heights of 42, 40, and 48 respectively. CONTROLS: Click bars between pockets to push two blocks into the neighbor or pull two blocks back from the neighbor. RULE: Blocks stop moving if they hit the lower bar between two pockets, creating a hard ceiling for that space. TRAP: Assuming you can fill a pocket completely ignores the invisible bar tip that blocks the final few blocks.

ESTABLISHED: The goal is a horizontal train: Box, R, N, b in slots 1, 2, 3. FAILED: Vertical moves or misaligned horizontal shifts fail to form this specific sequence. GOAL IS NOT: Vertical alignment, scattered blocks, or incorrect left-to-right ordering. CONTROLS: UP/DOWN moves the row; LEFT/RIGHT shifts blocks within the row if space permits.

GOAL: Align seven rotating glyph slots to match the target sequence shown in the pink row above. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows rotate the selected slot; up and down arrows change which slot is active. RULE: Each slot cycles through glyphs in a fixed order; rotating one step changes the label by one position in that cycle. TRAP: Assuming the target sequence runs right-to-left when it actually follows the left-to-right positional order of the yellow groups.

GOAL: Reach the green target without triggering the red block's lethal lunge. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player one room in that direction. RULE: The red block attacks only if you enter its row while it is awake. TRAP: Believing the red block chases you vertically; it stays still unless you step into its horizontal path.

GOAL: Match the blue strip to the secret code derived from the yellow domino patterns. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; pressing down or up cycles the symbol under the cursor through the blue alphabet. RULE: Each yellow domino reveals a letter, and the sequence of these letters forms the required code for the blue slots. TRAP: Assuming the cursor wraps automatically when moving past the edge; you must manually navigate back to the start if you overshoot.

GOAL: Configure a moving path for the cup by setting specific switch states in the first column. CONTROLS: Click horizontal or vertical switches to toggle their color between black and white. RULE: Black switches at specific positions determine movement direction; white switches are neutral. TRAP: Assuming all switches in a column must be active; leaving some white is essential for correct movement.

GOAL: Connect the train to the box using the extending rod. CONTROLS: Arrows move the train; the rod grows when the train moves right. RULE: The train must press against the rod while the rod is extended. TRAP: Thinking the rod pushes blocks; it actually grows behind them, requiring you to extend it first to create a connection.

GOAL: Align rotating glyphs to match the target. CONTROLS: Arrows shift slots; DOWN cycles glyphs through states. RULE: Each slot has a fixed cycle length; match the exact pixel pattern. TRAP: Assuming shape labels define states; rotation changes the pixel set, breaking simple label matching.

GOAL: Place both colored crosses precisely over their matching target dots. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active cross; Spacebar switches between the yellow and blue crosses. RULE: Each key press moves the cross exactly three grid units in that direction. TRAP: Assuming moves were single-unit caused overshooting; always count steps in multiples of three.

GOAL: Collect all red items to clear the level within a strict action limit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one room at a time between connected spaces. RULE: Never enter the room directly in front of a live red item; only approach from its sides or back. TRAP: Assuming red items are static obstacles; they are safe to collect only after removing the threat to their front room.

GOAL: Extend two colored bars until their tips fill matching sockets. CONTROLS: Click directional cells on each bar to extend or retract its length. RULE: Bars automatically stop one step short of the socket center, filling the gap. TRAP: Assuming the tip must land exactly on the socket center leads to overshooting and wasted moves.

GOAL: Rotate the ring to place the yellow block into the highlighted slot. CONTROLS: Red clicks rotate colors counter-clockwise; green clicks rotate them clockwise. RULE: The yellow dashed marker defines the target position for the yellow block. TRAP: Assuming other blocks or arrows matter; only the yellow block’s position relative to the marker solves the puzzle.

GOAL: Clear the board by jumping pegs over each other into empty spaces until only one remains. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it and reveal a ghost preview. Click the ghost location to execute the jump. RULE: A peg can only jump over an adjacent peg into an immediately following empty space, removing the jumped piece. TRAP: Assuming you can jump over empty spaces or land on occupied squares; jumps strictly require a peg to hop over and an empty landing spot.

GOAL: Move the pen blob into the dashed ring target. CONTROLS: Clicking an open cell moves the cursor there; clicking the blob swaps its position with the cursor. RULE: The cursor and blob positions must sum to the ring's center coordinates to solve the puzzle. TRAP: Believing the white diamond was the object to move, ignoring that the blob shares the ring's color.

GOAL: Make the highlighted panel's large cells match its small preview pattern. CONTROLS: Click a large cell to toggle its color between blue and red. RULE: The small preview shows the exact target pattern, not a live reflection of the large grid. TRAP: Assuming the preview updates automatically as you change the large grid, leading to confusion about the true goal.

GOAL: Match the two mini patterns to the main grid using the overlapping row logic. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their color between blue and orange. RULE: The middle row of the top mini must perfectly match the top row of the bottom mini. TRAP: Assuming the center orange dot is a clickable target instead of just a static marker.

GOAL: Rotate rings to place two yellow tiles into the marked bottom-right slots. CONTROLS: Click red arrows to shift rings clockwise; click green arrows to shift them counter-clockwise. RULE: Top and middle rings share corner tiles, so moving one affects the other. TRAP: Assuming rings move independently leads to endless loops when trying to align shared corners.

GOAL: Guide a cursor to cover colored dots using shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Space switches shapes. RULE: Shapes must fully cover dots of their matching color. TRAP: Assuming any shape covers any dot; only matching colors register coverage.

GOAL: Slide tokens along two interlocking loops to reach specific target spots. CONTROLS: Click left or right arrows to rotate the corresponding loop one step. RULE: The loops share two corner positions, allowing tokens to switch between them. TRAP: Assuming loops are separate circles causes failed transfers; they overlap at the center.

GOAL: Place two blocks into their matching ring sockets. CONTROLS: Click a block to select it; arrow keys slide the selected block. RULE: Rings are passable barriers that only trap blocks when they land fully inside. TRAP: Assuming rings blocked movement; clicking distant blocks directly was the shortcut, not pushing.

GOAL: Cover all target dots by moving three distinct shapes to their correct grid positions. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the currently active shape; the spacebar cycles to the next shape in the sequence. RULE: Only one shape responds to inputs at a time, requiring you to cycle through them to position each piece individually. TRAP: Assuming the cycle order is arbitrary; it is fixed, so pressing spacebar too many times wastes actions returning to the start.

GOAL: Fill the grid to match hidden patterns derived from four reference thumbnails. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to toggle their state to match the target configuration. RULE: Each thumbnail represents a transformed version of the final pattern; identify which transforms apply to deduce the solution. TRAP: Assuming all thumbnails are identical or require simple inversion; they actually use complex rotations and reflections that must be individually decoded.

ESTABLISHED: The cup moves freely, overwriting apparent walls to enter the corridor. It reached the corridor's base directly below the box. FAILED: Moving right three times did not clear the level; it only positioned the cup for an upward move. GOAL IS NOT: Simply shifting the cup horizontally or avoiding obstacles. CONTROLS: UP moves the cup one room upward; RIGHT moves it horizontally. The cup ignores collision with specific background textures.

GOAL: Move yellow to center and orange to the edge. CONTROLS: Arrows shift tokens along invisible loops through walls. RULE: Right arrows push tokens to the next slot, wrapping across rows. TRAP: Assuming tokens stay in their row; they teleport to the opposite side’s start.

ESTABLISHED: Two blocks start in mirrored lower chambers. The maze has a central seam and narrow upper corridors. Walls block direct vertical movement in specific spots. FAILED: Trying to make the blocks adjacent in the top center corridor did not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply having the two blocks touch each other in the middle of the top row. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously; left block moves as commanded, right block mirrors the horizontal direction.

GOAL: Guide two blocks to flank the central seam in the top corridor. CONTROLS: Arrows move both blocks simultaneously, mirroring each other across the vertical centerline. RULE: Success requires perfect symmetry, placing blocks on opposite sides of the center column. TRAP: Assuming blocks must touch directly; true symmetry prevents them from occupying adjacent cells.

GOAL: Color shapes to match dot boxes, then cover them. CONTROLS: Arrows move active shape; Space switches to other. RULE: Touching a box permanently recolors the active shape. TRAP: Color does not fade when moving away from the box.

ESTABLISHED: Entering the tail room shifts the snake head to a linked position. The head is currently at (40,22), blocking the target path. The gray block at (10,22) seems significant. FAILED: Trying to push the head further directly. Standard movement loops without altering the snake's rest state. Assuming the head is static when the player is away. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the exit while the snake is in its initial configuration. The head's position is dynamic, not fixed. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player. SPACE previously reverted position to the last spot, acting as an undo or reset

GOAL: Deduce the hidden color for every cell based on partial clues. CONTROLS: Click cells to cycle their color from blue to red to orange. RULE: White windows reveal the true color, while gray windows forbid the center's color. TRAP: Assuming one click always reaches the final color; gray clues often require two clicks to land on orange.

GOAL: Place both yellow pieces on the two marked slots. CONTROLS: Arrows rotated the large loop or the top row of pieces. RULE: The loops shared five positions, so rotating one loop moved pieces between tracks. TRAP: Thinking the loops were independent; moving a piece on the shared row affected both cycles simultaneously.

GOAL: Navigate a narrow corridor to reach the exit marker. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player one space in that direction. RULE: The path is constrained by walls, forcing a specific route through the corridor. TRAP: Assuming you can move freely in any direction; walls block unintended paths.

GOAL: Place four blocks into their matching outlines. CONTROLS: Click to select a block, use arrows to slide it. RULE: Active blocks can slide through walls, but only land in open spaces. TRAP: Trying to move an inactive block wastes actions; select the correct piece first.

GOAL: Align the moving piece with the yellow target outline to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the active piece; clicks selected pieces to determine which one responded to input. RULE: The game mirrors movement between panels, so moving one piece moves its reflection in the opposite direction. TRAP: Assuming the yellow piece was controllable wasted time; it was merely the static goal marker, not the player's avatar.

GOAL: Move the player across the gap to reach the exit using only three actions. CONTROLS: Click the right blue button to shift the world left, moving the player right. Click the left button to shift the world right. RULE: The player’s screen position stays fixed while the world shifts underneath, changing which side of the wall you occupy. TRAP: Believing the player moves independently on the screen, causing you to click the wrong direction and waste actions.

GOAL: Collect two separated rings and deposit them into matching slots to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; Space absorbs a ring when aligned or deposits it when carrying. RULE: You can carry only one ring at a time, requiring you to return to slots individually. TRAP: Assuming you could grab both rings before placing any; this wastes time as you must drop one to pick up the next.

GOAL: Navigate the 3x3 player avatar from the starting white floor to the green target corner. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player two cells in that direction, jumping over gray intermediate tiles. RULE: Movement is only possible if the destination cell is not a blue wall block. TRAP: Believing gray tiles are permanent obstacles rather than passable gaps between valid landing spots.

GOAL: Align the wall's reflection to cover the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active object; Space switches active focus between wall and piece. RULE: Moving the wall shifts its reflection twice as fast in the opposite direction. TRAP: Assuming arrows move the piece while the wall is active, causing wasted actions on no-ops.

GOAL: Slide your green block right to align with the target slot. CONTROLS: Clicking above a wall shifts the upper section right; clicking below shifts the lower section right. RULE: Move the middle section first to create space for the bottom section to slide further right. TRAP: Trying to move the bottom section directly fails if the middle section hasn't shifted enough to clear the path.

GOAL: Align the plug tips with the socket pins to complete the circuit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug one grid step per press. RULE: Vertical alignment must occur before horizontal insertion to avoid collision. TRAP: Believing horizontal movement works before vertical alignment wastes actions on blocked paths.

GOAL: Align the L-piece and its reflection with distant targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active piece; Space switches control between the piece and its mirror. RULE: The mirror reflects movement vertically but preserves horizontal direction, requiring coordinated positioning. TRAP: Assuming the mirror moves opposite horizontally; it does not, so moving right shifts both pieces right.

ESTABLISHED: Arrow keys move only the green tile within its fixed gray box. Red and blue pieces are static. Clicking the green tile itself produces no change. FAILED: Clicking the yellow tile or its container. Moving red or blue pieces. Attempting to make yellow and green tiles overlap. GOAL IS NOT: Filling right-side T-shapes. Moving the containers themselves. Combining yellow and green tiles into one. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the green tile by one cell. Mouse clicks on tiles or containers are currently inert.

ESTABLISHED: The block is currently all purple. The hopper holds white paint. FAILED: Rotating to 0 degrees before pouring white overwrites the bottom half. GOAL IS NOT: A pattern where the top half is white but the bottom has white triangles. CONTROLS: LEFT rotates counter-clockwise. DOWN rotates clockwise. Select swatch to change color. Pour paints the visible side.

GOAL: Paint the top half white and the bottom half purple. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the paint nozzle; mouse clicks select colors; space pours paint in the nozzle's direction. RULE: Paint pours diagonally, covering only cells where the row and column indices satisfy the angle's inequality. TRAP: Pouring white from the top first leaves stray white pixels in the bottom half that are hard to cover later.

ESTABLISHED: Removing the overhead block creates a clear vertical water column, triggering buoyancy. The player rises when moving into such an open column connected to a higher water body. FAILED: Moving horizontally into a column still capped by a block does not cause rising. Clicking to remove side blocks without clearing the vertical path above the player fails. GOAL IS NOT: Simply clearing adjacent side blocks or moving to a new column without ensuring the path above is fully open to the upper room. CONTROLS: Clicking removes specific block segments. Arrow keys move the player and trigger

GOAL: Align the mirror, U-piece, and bar with their yellow silhouettes. CONTROLS: Arrows move the highlighted piece; Space cycles selection to the next piece. RULE: Pieces pass through each other and the mirror, so move in any order without blocking. TRAP: Thinking the mirror must move last to avoid occlusion; it actually moves first or last freely.

GOAL: Rise to the surface and touch the pink cross to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character left or right; clicking blocks clears them. RULE: Clearing blocks above you causes immediate buoyancy, lifting you to the surface. TRAP: Assuming the cross is solid and blocks movement, rather than being a win trigger.

GOAL: Raise colored columns to match specific height markers by moving blocks between adjacent zones. CONTROLS: Clicking a column moves one block from the left neighbor into it, or from it into the right neighbor. RULE: Each zone has a ceiling height; blocks cannot stack above the lowest wall boundary defining that zone. TRAP: Assuming walls only block horizontal movement, ignoring that they also cap the maximum vertical fill height per zone.

GOAL: Reach the exit by sliding across green ice tiles. CONTROLS: Arrows slide you in that direction until you hit a wall or obstacle. RULE: The red enemy only attacks left; standing below it keeps you safe. TRAP: Assuming enemies strike in all directions caused unnecessary detours.

GOAL: Rotate the cursor to the correct slot and cycle the glyph until it matches the target shape. CONTROLS: Left and right arrows move the selection cursor; the up arrow rotates the current glyph through its cycle. RULE: Each glyph follows a strict, repeating sequence, so counting steps from a known start guarantees the correct result. TRAP: Assuming the rotation direction is ambiguous or random leads to overshooting the target and wasting moves on unnecessary cycles.

GOAL: Catch the falling magenta block with the blue platform. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the platform; Space releases the block. RULE: The platform must be positioned directly beneath the drop path before release. TRAP: Releasing early causes the block to miss and the level to reset immediately.

ESTABLISHED: The ball always returns to start. Black keys make the target wobble left once; gray keys do nothing. FAILED: All-gray and all-black patterns did not clear. Clicking the ball, strip, tube, or U-interior produced no change. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching a color pattern or clicking the ball to move it. CONTROLS: Mouse clicks toggle tile colors or probe objects; clicking black keys triggers a target wobble animation.

GOAL: Guide the block safely past the stationary red guards. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the player in straight lines until hitting a wall or object. RULE: Red guards instantly strike any adjacent cell the moment you stop next to them. TRAP: Believing you can stop adjacent to a guard; you must land at least one cell away.

GOAL: Move the purple square to the ball. CONTROLS: Click a dot three steps ahead to pull the square forward. RULE: Only dots exactly three cells away allow movement. TRAP: Believing the white cross was the finish line wasted time.

GOAL: Fill four empty slots with colored blocks to match the target sequence shown above the board. CONTROLS: Click a color in the bottom tray to select it, then click a gray slot to place it. RULE: The target row defines the exact left-to-right color order required for the solution. TRAP: Assuming you can drag blocks directly; they only move via the two-step select-then-place click method.

GOAL: Match the yellow row's glyphs to the pink row's specific symbols. CONTROLS: Arrows navigate the cursor; pressing UP or DOWN cycles through available symbol options in the selected slot. RULE: Only the symbol's identity matters; its rotational pose is irrelevant to the solution check. TRAP: Wasting actions trying to align rotations, believing the puzzle required matching both shape and orientation exactly.

GOAL: Decode a hidden message by matching yellow word lengths to blue glyphs using a lookup table. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the current blue glyph through a cycle of shapes to match the target. RULE: Segment the yellow sentence into words, then stack the corresponding blue glyphs to form the solution. TRAP: Assuming every blue shape is unique; some distinct table entries actually share the same visual class.

GOAL: Move the target down five spaces by activating keys. CONTROLS: Click keys to toggle bar and stem colors; click the blob to move the target. RULE: A black stem moves the target down; a black bar moves it left. TRAP: Thinking both parts must be black for a downward move, when only the stem matters.

GOAL: Cover all marked dots using the center of your colored cross. CONTROLS: Arrows move the active cross; Space switches between yellow and blue. RULE: Dots are cleared only when fully hidden beneath the cross’s center. TRAP: Thinking arms alone count; moving just the center to align with the dot is required.

GOAL: Move two dots along bars to cross centers. CONTROLS: Click glyphs to move dots three steps. RULE: Each click moves the dot a fixed distance. TRAP: Assuming clicks move one step causes overshooting.

GOAL: Arrange seven colored tiles to match a target sequence. CONTROLS: Click to swap tiles; press Space to check the result. RULE: The target order follows the left box, then the right box, skipping the blocked slot. TRAP: Assuming the blocked slot in the right box shifts the sequence position of the remaining tiles.

GOAL: Guide the player to the exit by activating all colored blocks. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the character and drag connected blocks along the path. RULE: A block is activated when the player passes over it, turning its legend icon white. TRAP: Blocks do not activate just by being on the path; the player must physically traverse them.

GOAL: Place seven letters into a chain of red, green, and blue slots to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a letter in the tray to pick it up, then click a slot to place it. Press space to finish. RULE: Letters must be placed in the flattened order of the connected boxes, ignoring the linking markers. TRAP: Assuming every red slot is fillable wastes time; the marker slots are blocked and cannot accept pieces.

GOAL: Merge two pink blocks into one, then carry it to the goal. CONTROLS: Click a cell to move a nearby block closer to that spot. RULE: Clicking between two same-color blocks within range merges them into a single larger block. TRAP: Assuming distance is Euclidean; use grid steps (Chebyshev) to calculate reach.

GOAL: Move the white diamond's center onto the ring's target dot. CONTROLS: Click empty space to move the white diamond; click the gray diamond to swap positions. RULE: The level clears when the white diamond fully covers the specific target dot in the ring. TRAP: Believing you must clear every dot in the ring; only the designated center target matters.

GOAL: Move all three shapes to their specific target centers to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide the currently active shape one step; Spacebar switches the active shape. RULE: Only the shape under the white cursor moves; verify the cursor position before pressing arrows. TRAP: Assuming Spacebar cycles shapes in a fixed order; it actually toggles based on spatial proximity.

ESTABLISHED: Clicking target cells triggers a global gray flash. The key tip currently sits at its leftmost position, blocked from moving further left. FAILED: Pressing LEFT repeatedly after the flash did not insert the key. Clicking cells after the flash had no effect. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the pattern to trigger the flash, nor moving the tip to the leftmost edge. CONTROLS: Cell clicks flash corresponding keypad cells. Arrow keys move the key tip within its track.

GOAL: Guide two separate dots to meet at the top center block. CONTROLS: Arrows move both dots simultaneously; horizontal inputs are mirrored for the right dot. RULE: A dot stops if its path is blocked, allowing the other to continue moving alone. TRAP: Assuming both dots move equally; ignoring that a blocked dot halts while the partner advances wastes turns.

GOAL: Place pieces to spell a hidden word in the correct color-coded sequence. CONTROLS: Click tray items to select; click board slots to place; use SPACE to confirm. RULE: Locked pieces act as fixed clues; only movable slots count toward the final answer. TRAP: Assuming all visible slots must be filled; ignore the permanent marker and focus only on the seven active positions.

GOAL: Align the yellow block with the yellow marker. CONTROLS: Red buttons rotated the ring counter-clockwise; green rotated it clockwise. RULE: The ring rotates as a whole, shifting every block one slot per click. TRAP: Assuming individual blocks could be moved independently instead of rotating the entire structure.

GOAL: Arrange colored tiles to match a hidden sequence generated by nested slots. CONTROLS: Click tray items to select, click grid slots to place, press space to validate. RULE: Two markers inserted into the outer row duplicate the inner row’s contents, creating two identical triples. TRAP: Assuming each slot holds only one unique item; markers actually act as repeat commands, not distinct values.

GOAL: Fill child boxes and arrange markers in the parent box to match the target sequence. CONTROLS: Click tray items to place them into empty slots; click empty slots to return items to the tray. RULE: The parent box acts as a container; each marker expands into its corresponding child box’s three items in left-to-right order. TRAP: Assuming the parent box slots hold single items rather than representing entire child boxes, causing misplaced pieces and invalid sequences.

GOAL: Trace the diamond outline to find the missing pixel. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor; Space selects the spot. RULE: The shape is defined by diagonal lines where row plus or minus column remains constant. TRAP: Assuming standard square coordinates for the diamond’s edges instead of diagonal offsets.

GOAL: Charge the key by matching green cells to the target diamond. CONTROLS: Click cells to cycle their color; use arrow keys to move the key. RULE: The key shrinks only when green cells exactly match the target shape. TRAP: Clicking a white cell immediately after reset does nothing; wait for the system to wake up.

GOAL: Rotate the dial to the target symbol and push the block into the exit box. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player and push the block; standing on the sparkle rotates the dial. RULE: The win condition requires the dial to match the target symbol exactly when the block enters the exit. TRAP: Covering the sparkle multiple times wastes actions and misaligns the dial from the required target state.

GOAL: Place both yellow tokens onto the cursor targets at the far right of their respective rows. CONTROLS: Red clicks rotate rings clockwise; green clicks rotate them counter-clockwise. RULE: Tokens only move when their ring rotates; they never jump between rings. TRAP: Assuming you can align one token without disturbing the other’s position on a shared ring.

GOAL: Guide two dots through a grid to specific targets. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the active dot left, right, up, or down. RULE: Both dots move simultaneously; they stop if blocked by a wall. TRAP: Assuming independent movement wastes turns; you must coordinate paths to avoid collisions.

ESTABLISHED: The platform stops at rows 48-51, seemingly blocked by the block's proximity. FAILED: Attempting to push the block by positioning the platform at rows 52-55 or lower. GOAL IS NOT: Simply dropping the block into a hole, as red bars currently block all drop paths. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the platform; collision with the block prevents downward movement near its column.

GOAL: Move all four pegs to the bottom-right corner. CONTROLS: Click a peg to select it, then click an empty spot to slide it there. RULE: Pegs slide until they hit a wall or another peg, then stop. TRAP: Thinking you can stop a peg early; you cannot, so plan paths that avoid blocking your own pieces.

GOAL: Paint the large grid to match the central key pattern. CONTROLS: Click grid blocks to toggle their colors between blue and red.
